title: ci: build math.pdf in docs job — install IEEE template, LaTeX packages, and tikz-cd
body:
The `docs` CI job fails to compile `math.tex` because `IEEEtran.cls` and several required LaTeX packages (`tikz-cd`, `mathtools`, `cleveref`, etc.) are absent from the runner.

## Changes

- **Install LaTeX packages** via `apt-get`: `latexmk`, `texlive-latex-extra`, `texlive-science`, `texlive-pictures`, `texlive-fonts-recommended`
- **Download IEEE journal template** from the official IEEE template selector API and unzip into `docs/` to provide `IEEEtran.cls`
- **Install `tikz-cd`** via `tlmgr` in user mode with an explicit CTAN repository URL (not included reliably in the apt TeX Live packages):
  ```yaml
  - name: Install tikz-cd via tlmgr
    run: |
      tlmgr init-usertree
      tlmgr --usermode --repository https://mirror.ctan.org/systems/texlive/tlnet install tikz-cd
  ```
